# Scraper de Instagram.com

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/instagram-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/instagram-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta conjuntos de dados de usuários e de posts de usuários do Instagram.com, escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape Instagram in 2025](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-instagram)
- **Código:** [`instagram.py`](instagram.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [User data](results/user.json) · [All user posts](results/all-user-posts.json) · [Multi image post](results/multi-image-post.json) · [Video Post](results/video-post.json) · [Post comments](results/post-comments.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Informações de usuários do Instagram.com
- Posts de usuários do Instagram.com

## Funções

- `scrape_user(username)` → `Dict`: Scrape instagram user's data
- `scrape_post(url_or_shortcode)` → `Dict`: Scrape single Instagram post data by parsing the HTML page
- `scrape_user_posts(username, page_size=12, max_pages=None)`: Scrape the posts of an instagram user (logged out) of given the username
- `scrape_post_comments(url)`: Scrape comments from an Instagram post

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import instagram


async def main():
    user = await instagram.scrape_user("google")
    post = await instagram.scrape_post("https://www.instagram.com/p/Cs9iEotsiGY/")
    user_posts = await instagram.scrape_user_posts("google", max_pages=3)
    post_comments = await instagram.scrape_post_comments("https://www.instagram.com/p/Csthn7EO99u/")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos da saída de exemplo (chaves de primeiro nível do primeiro item):

- [`results/user.json`](results/user.json): `name`, `username`, `id`, `bio`, `bio_links`, `followers`, `follows`, `facebook_id`, `is_private`, `is_verified`, `is_memorialized`, `pronouns`, `account_badges`, `threads_handle`, `profile_image`, `highlights`
- [`results/all-user-posts.json`](results/all-user-posts.json): `id`, `shortcode`, `url`, `media_type`, `product_type`, `caption`, `src`, `owner`, `owner_id`, `carousel_media_count`
- [`results/multi-image-post.json`](results/multi-image-post.json): `id`, `shortcode`, `src`, `src_attached`, `likes`, `taken_at`, `location`, `captions`, `comments_count`, `comments`
- [`results/video-post.json`](results/video-post.json): `id`, `shortcode`, `dimensions`, `src`, `thumbnail_src`, `media_preview`, `video_url`, `views`, `likes`, `location`, `taken_at`, `related`, `type`, `video_duration`, `music`, `is_video`, `tagged_users`, `captions`, `related_profiles`, `comments_count`, `comments_disabled`, `comments_next_page`, `comments`
- [`results/post-comments.json`](results/post-comments.json): `id`, `text`, `created_at`, `owner`, `owner_id`, `owner_verified`, `owner_profile_pic`, `likes`

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`instagram.py`](instagram.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"CA"`: país do proxy

## Observações

Observação: este scraper extrai apenas dados públicos do Instagram que não exigem login para acessar.

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/instagram-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_user_scraping`, `test_post_scraping`, `test_user_post_scraping`, `test_post_comments_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
